title: Job inbox
risk: Possible content aimed at an AI

empty.title: Your inbox is empty
empty.body: Add a job from its URL or by pasting the text. Then “Assess new jobs” reads it, pulls out its details and assesses whether it fits you.

guide.label: What this stage is and how to move on

all.what: All your jobs, whatever their stage. Each job moves along: To complete → To read → To review → Approved → CV ready → Applied → In process.
all.next: pick a stage in the row below to see only its jobs and what to do with them.

pending_detail.what: Jobs that reached you as a summary, usually from LinkedIn email alerts: their description is missing. For safety your agent doesn't go into LinkedIn, so you do this step yourself with the browser's “Send to CandidatAI” button.

steps.open: Click Open on a job: it opens on its job board (on LinkedIn, signed in).
steps.send: In that tab, click the Send to CandidatAI button in the browser toolbar. It saves the description and the job moves to “To read”.
steps.discard: If the title already tells you it's not for you, discard it right here, without opening it.

pending_detail.extension: Don't have the button yet? <extension>Install it in a few minutes</extension>. You can also go through them one by one, with keyboard shortcuts, in <alerts>To complete</alerts>.

pending_extraction.what: Jobs with their full description that your agent hasn't read yet.
pending_extraction.next: click “Assess new jobs”. Your agent pulls out the role, skills, work mode and salary of each one, the app calculates its fit (0 to 100) against your profile and your agent explains why it fits or not. Those that don't pass your filters (work mode, location…) close by themselves; the rest move to “To review”.

pending_triage.what: Jobs already read and with their fit calculated, waiting for your decision.
pending_triage.next: go through them in <triage>Quick review</triage> and approve or discard them. If any doesn't have an assessment yet, “Assess the jobs to review” has your agent compare it with your profile and write why it fits or not. It doesn't change the stage: you decide.

approved.what: Jobs you approved. They still need their tailored CV.
approved.next: open each one and, in the “Application” tab, click “Generate CV”. Your agent writes it using only your profile and checks it; once it's there, the job moves to “CV ready”.

cv_ready.what: Jobs with their tailored CV ready, not sent yet.
cv_ready.next: in each job's “Application” tab, review the CV, prepare the cover letter or the answers if asked, and send the application yourself on the job board. Then click “Mark as sent” and it moves to “Applied”.

applied.what: Applications sent, waiting for the company to answer.
applied.next: when they invite you to an interview or a test, note it in the job's “Process” tab, or accept the proposal in <replies>Replies</replies> if the app read the email, and it moves to “In process”. If they take long to answer, the app reminds you to follow up.

in_process.what: Processes with interviews or tests under way.
in_process.next: follow them in <processes>Processes</processes>: note each interview, prepare it with your agent and record how it ends, with an offer or a closure.

closed.what: The end of the road: jobs discarded, rejected, expired, duplicated or that didn't pass your filters.
closed.next: nothing to do. If you closed one by mistake, open it and click “Reopen”.

guide.openComplete: Go through them one by one

noScoreWhy.profile: Fit not calculated: your profile is missing. Create it in “My profile”.
noScoreWhy.unread: Fit not calculated: your agent hasn't read the job yet.
